text:
noah: follow-up from the design huddle  proposing a "handoff broker" but want to call out tenant-opt-out semantics and probe behaviour. main goal: avoid mandatory sidecars while keeping private installs untouched.

anya: short summary of expected behaviours?

noah: broker mediates manifest negotiation and issues ephemeral runtime leases. two paths: tunnel (fast path) and inspect-proxy (audit path). tenants can opt-out in manifest or org settings to force direct routing. broker stores no persistent secrets.

caoimhe: key concern: when a tenant opts out, do we still surface health telemetry from the broker for that traffic? we must avoid leaking hosted telemetry into private installs.

noah: plan is opt-out = broker is bypassed for policy + handshake. however we will still accept optional telemetry headers from the runtime if the private control-plane explicitly enables cross-reporting. default: no broker-level telemetry for opt-out tenants.

ben: what does opt-out look like in the manifest? it should be a single small boolean so private stacks don't need to change.

noah: proposed manifest snippet (optional and backwards compatible):

{"runtime":{"handoff":{"use_broker":"auto"}}} 

where use_broker can be "auto" (default), "always", or "never". vendors can set "never" to opt out.

anya: sounds good. next: probe behaviour. clients and control-plane probes need to verify both broker and runtime in a way that doesn't cause accidental failovers. propose separate probe endpoints: /health/runtime and /health/broker. probes should respect opt-out.

caoimhe: security: recommend mTLS for broker->runtime, PoP tokens for broker->client handshake, and strict replay detection. broker must rotate certs automatically and expose cert status in dashboards.

ben: perf: add latency budget for the tunnel path (e.g., <=3ms median extra inside region) and for proxy path (<=12ms). if broker cannot meet budget, control-plane should force tunnel or let client fallback.

noah: rollout: start with internal tenants + small PLG cohort, enable feature-flag per-region, provide per-tenant opt-in toggle in control-plane. create global kill switch.

infra-bot: created infra taskboard: https://infra/tasks/hand-off-broker-canary  includes mTLS, canary, FF, dashboards, and cert rotation runbook.

anya: tests: 1) opt-out correctness (no broker involvement), 2) telemetry isolation (no hosted metrics visible for opted-out tenants), 3) probe false-positive resilience, 4) mid-stream credential rotation. I'll own test matrix.

caoimhe: add compliance check  ensure broker logs do not contain model payloads or PII and apply retention policies.

noah: great catches. I'll fold these into the RFC: sequence diagrams for auto/always/never, probe endpoints, SLOs, and rollout plan. will post draft tomorrow for 72h review. thanks.
